rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement says each link to a file of specialized material MUST say when to read the file. The skill has three such links, and each one says when:
- `[CI example](references/ci.md)`: "Use the CI example when adding these steps to an existing workflow". This is in the testing and coverage section, where it is also tied to setting up or reviewing project CI.
- `[references/distributed-requirements.md]`: read it "for an obligation that applies separately at each of many sites… before drafting it, and whenever you edit a `{req}` that contains `{sites}` or `{violations}`".
- `[references/syntax-details.md]`: read it "if a file that implements or tests a requirement cannot carry a comment, such as a shipped skill or a stylesheet… or a requirement lives in a nested chapter".

The mention of the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md` is a code span, not a link, and it belongs to another skill. The requirement doesn't cover it. No violation matches were listed. The site meets the requirement.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
